identity_observations.finding: The 2016 annual report identifies Sears common stock as SHLD. This is an issuer observation, not an all-dates security mapping.
A separate ETF listed using SHLD in September 2023. Its prices cannot be assigned to Sears shares.
The 2022 annual report associates BBBY common stock with the original issuer; the CIK identifies the issuer, not every share class.
Beyond adopted BBBY effective 2025-08-29; this is a different issuer from the old BBBY company.
The old issuer renamed its shares TFCFA/TFCF during the 2019 separation while the new Fox traded as FOXA/FOX. A continuous FOXA ticker interval does not establish security continuity.
New Fox began standalone regular trading on 2019-03-19 following a share distribution. Source prices require separate security and distribution accounting.

The former Ingersoll-Rand plc became Trane Technologies and traded as TT on 2020-03-02; its industrial segment combined with Gardner Denver. A continuous IR interval spans a material identity transition.
The post-transaction IR issuer has CIK 0001699150, separate from the former Ingersoll-Rand plc filer. These CIK observations still do not certify raw share-class history.

The merger closed on 2017-07-25 while the index announcement specified deletion before 2017-07-26. Candidate history ends 2017-07-24; trading availability and index membership must be reconciled separately.

source_limitations: First candidate derives its old baseline from a book-associated dataset and updates with selected changes; full independent baseline remains unverified.
Second source appends a current Wikipedia snapshot dated at collection time, deduplicating only identical date/ticker pairs; observations are not necessarily effective event dates.
Neither agreement nor two verified boundaries proves all intervening membership or correct security prices.
Some original documents are readable through the web reader but not directly downloadable; missing byte archives are explicit.
